title: Cardiac evaluation of young athletes: Time for a risk-based approach?
claims: The review states that up to 80% of young athletes are asymptomatic prior to sudden cardiac arrest or sudden cardiac death.
The review states that the AHA recommends screening all athletes with a 14-element assessment via medical history and physical examination, with secondary evaluation for any positive element.
The review describes the AHA's history-and-physical approach as widely practised but limited, and argues for a risk-based approach to screening.
